ablation_gate: candidate safe accepts are no fewer than the global-normal base and at least one base false-safe is repaired to a candidate safe accept
b5_method: PCA-anisotropic Delaunay filtration with frozen Phase-0 local-scale multiplier and maximum normal penalty
base_ablation: unchanged global-normal parallel-layer inference and per-layer 2D Delaunay construction with the same observed-only gate
candidate_gate: unchanged Phase-7 SharedTrendConfig with k=12, minimum cluster fraction 0.20, separation SNR 3.0, and cross-kNN fraction 0.05
candidate_method: unchanged shared quadratic trend fit, residual two-means, observed-only sampling gate, and one 2D Delaunay surface per inferred layer
claim_boundary: a positive result supports only a sampling-sufficient, globally separable, non-outlier synthetic two-layer reconstruction method; it does not support outlier robustness, general alpha selection, PFTF conditioning, real transfer, exactness, or deployment
efficacy_gate: over all 144 cases, candidate mean F-score exceeds both B5 and M1 by at least 0.10, candidate mean geometry loss is strictly lower than both, and candidate wins F-score casewise against each on at least 75 percent of cases
held_out_prohibition: no Phase-50 point, label, reference, endpoint, or aggregate may alter the candidate, baseline parameters, thresholds, case set, or gates
information_boundary: candidate routing uses observed coordinates only; stress identity, true layer labels, clean reference points, and baseline endpoints are evaluation-only
m1_method: regular weighted-Delaunay power-alpha filtration at the independently calibrated B4-dominating design point
phase_gate: all configuration identity checks plus safety, efficacy, topology, and ablation gates must pass without retuning
pose_rule: derive one 3x3 Gaussian matrix from case_seed+7000001, use QR, make the diagonal sign deterministic, correct determinant to +1, and apply the same proper rotation to observed and reference points
safety_gate: candidate false-safe count is zero; overall safe-acceptance coverage is at least 0.95; every point-count x stress subgroup is at least 0.90
source_candidate: frozen Phase-7 shared-trend residual layer inference
topology_gate: candidate aggregate topology error and nonmanifold-edge count are zero, while each of B5 and M1 has strictly positive aggregate topology error
